title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: customer-first direct callback with callback profiles
summary: The briefing is supported by the roadmap record and Microsoft documentation. The irreversible onboarding, callback profile controls, Dataverse operations and credit-consumption warning are documented; the absence of an API for the complete onboarding sequence is appropriately distinguished from the documented configuration-record update.

claims.claim: Classic direct callback assigns a request to a representative before calling the customer, leaving the representative waiting during the attempt.
claims.quote: In the classic direct callback experience, the system assigns a callback request to a representative before it calls the customer. If the customer doesn't answer, the call reaches voicemail, or the number is unavailable, the representative waits while the call attempt completes.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Customer-first callback calls the customer when the request reaches the front of the queue and a representative is available.
claims.quote: When the callback request reaches the front of the queue and at least one representative is available, the system initiates the callback.

claims.claim: The system connects a representative after the customer answers and completes any required verification.
claims.quote: After the customer answers and completes any required verification, the system connects the customer to an available representative.

claims.where: summary; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: An AI agent can engage customers, collect information or verify them before transfer to a representative.
claims.quote:
An AI agent can engage the customer, collect information, or perform verification.
6. The system transfers the customer to an available representative.

claims.where: title; What's changing; Scope; Governance controls
claims.claim: Administrators configure customer-first callback through callback profiles in Copilot Service admin center.
claims.quote: Customer-first direct callback introduces a configurable, AI-powered experience managed through "callback profiles" in the Copilot Service admin center.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: A callback profile configures the callback offer message.
claims.quote: Initial callback offer: Edit the default message that the system plays when customer opts for a callback.

claims.claim: A callback profile can ask customers for an alternate callback number.
claims.quote: Ask for alternate number: Select to call customers at a number of their choice.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: A callback profile can restrict when callbacks are offered.
claims.quote: Callback offering window: Turn on the toggle to define when the system can offer callback requests.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: A callback profile configures duplicate prevention.
claims.quote: Duplicate prevention: Choose the setting for the system to check for duplicates to prevent customers from creating multiple callback requests

claims.claim: Duplicate detection identifies existing callback requests using the customer's phone number.
claims.quote: The system performs duplicate detection only when the overflow action triggers a direct callback experience. It uses the customer phone number to identify existing callback requests.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Queue allocation limits the number of active callback requests per queue.
claims.quote: Queue allocation: Specify the maximum number of active callback requests that a queue can hold.

claims.claim: When the queue allocation limit is reached, callers continue through the standard queue experience.
claims.quote:
When the queue reaches the configured limit:

- The system stops offering callbacks.
- Customers continue through the standard queue experience.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: The profile configures the number used for outbound callbacks.
claims.quote: On the Dialing page, in Callback number, select one of the following options to determine the number from which callback is offered.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Using different phone platforms for inbound calls and outbound callbacks prevents callback initiation and closes the request.
claims.quote: For example, if a customer calls an Azure Communication Services number but the callback uses a Microsoft Teams number, the system doesn't initiate the callback and automatically closes the callback request.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: The profile selects the Copilot Studio agent used for engagement after the callback connects.
claims.quote: AI agent: Select the Copilot Studio agent that handles customer engagement after the callback connects.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: If the AI agent cannot engage the customer, the profile offers Prompt and hang up or Prompt and escalate as fallback actions.
claims.quote:
Fallback action: Select one of the following options and customize the prompt and prompt message if agent is unable to engage with the customer:

- Prompt and hang up
- Prompt and escalate

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Profile rules delay new callback attempts when average callback wait time exceeds the configured threshold.
claims.quote: The system continuously monitors recently dialed callbacks and, when the average wait time exceeds the configured threshold, automatically delays new callback attempts.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Profiles configure retry behavior for No answer, Failed and Answering machine outcomes.
claims.quote:
On the Behaviors page, in Retry Settings, select the retry options to configure the behavior for the following triggers:

- No answer
- Failed
- Answering machine

claims.claim: The minimum wait before retrying is five minutes.
claims.quote: Wait time: Select the duration in minutes or hours to wait before retrying. The minimum duration is five minutes.

claims.claim: One callback profile can be configured per overflow condition for a single queue.
claims.quote: You can configure one callback profile per overflow condition for a single queue.

claims.claim: The system automatically closes direct callback requests after seven days.
claims.quote: The system automatically closes direct callback requests after seven days.

claims.where: summary; Why it matters; Risk assessment: Change & support; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Customer-first direct callback cannot be disabled after enablement.
claims.quote: After you enable customer-first direct callback, you can't disable the feature.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance; rationale: risk
claims.claim: During initial setup, the first callback profile automatically applies to queues already using direct callback as an overflow action.
claims.quote: During initial setup, the first callback profile automatically applies to queues that already use direct callback as an overflow action.

claims.claim: Enabling customer-first direct callback prevents reverting to classic direct callback.
claims.quote: If you enable customer-first direct callback, it becomes the default callback experience and you can't revert to direct callback.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The feature requires administrator opt-in and does not start before enablement.
claims.quote:
You can't enable the feature until you create at least one callback profile.
6. Save the profile. After you save the first profile, the system enables customer-first direct callback and makes the profile available for queue configuration.

claims.quote: Licensing and usage requirements that apply to other AI agents also apply to callback agents.

claims.quote: Specific licensing requirements apply for each channel user to use voice, chat, and digital messaging in Dynamics 365 Contact Center with Dynamics 365 Customer Service or with the customer relationship management (CRM) solution of your choice. claims.claim: The mixed licensing model reflects the product's channel-user licensing requirements together with potential AI-agent credit consumption.
claims.quote: AI agent use can consume available Copilot or Microsoft service credits. Learn more in Understand usage-based billing and cost management for Copilot Credits. Licensing and usage requirements that apply to other AI agents also apply to callback agents.
